title: 交易脈動 Baseline 覆蓋：分母改用需要比較的數量、不需比較時顯示明確文字
hosted_verification_note: Verified locally via Vitest unit/component/adapter/i18n suites, TypeScript typecheck, contract drift check, Vite production build, and headless Chromium browser screenshot + DOM readback of /management/trading-pulse with all-paper fixture data.

acceptance_criteria.1_adapter_maps_baseline_required_count_a: verified: ManagementTradingPulseCoverage, ManagementTradingPulseSummary, TRADING_PULSE_COVERAGE_NUMBER_KEYS, normalizeTradingPulseSummary, and normalizeTradingPulseCardDetails map both baseline_required_count and baselineRequiredCount; TradingPulseCoverageSummary uses coverage.baselineRequiredCount as the denominator when positive (e.g. 1/1 or 1/2 instead of 1/4).
acceptance_criteria.2_fallback_to_runtime_count_when_absent: verified: When baseline_required_count / baselineRequiredCount is absent, normalizeTradingPulseCoverage and normalizeTradingPulseSummary leave it undefined and TradingPulseCoverageSummary falls back to runtimeCount (e.g. 76/90 on older BFF payloads, and '—' when baselineComparisonCount is also absent).
acceptance_criteria.3_zero_required_shows_localized_not_requ: verified: When baseline_required_count is 0, the Baseline coverage tile renders t('mgmt.pulse.notRequired') ('不需比較' in zh-TW, 'Not required' in en-US) instead of 0/N and renders status 'ok' with no degraded badge.
acceptance_criteria.4_non_empty_missing_baseline_runtime_ids: verified: When missing_baseline_runtime_ids is non-empty, the Baseline coverage tile status remains 'degraded' and lists the missing runtime ids via shortList(missingBaseline).
acceptance_criteria.5_row_not_required_neutral_localized_bad: verified: In RuntimeRowsPanel, a row with baselineComparison.status === 'not_required' renders a neutral badge (bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border from statusTone default branch) with localized text ('不需比較' in zh-TW, 'Not required' in en-US), while 'unavailable' keeps its warning tone (bg-status-warning/15 text-status-warning border-status-warning/30) and raw status text.
acceptance_criteria.6_focused_tests_i18n_parity_and_typechec: verified: Focused tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/management.test.ts, src/management/pages/oversight/TradingPulsePage.test.tsx, and src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts cover all four tile states, row badges in both locales, and i18n key parity; tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit and tsc -p tsconfig.agora.json --noEmit pass.
acceptance_criteria.7_evidence_records_commands_results_and_: verified: Exact commands, exit codes, test counts, and headless Chromium 1440x1200 screenshots + DOM readbacks for the 4-runtime all-paper fixture in both zh-TW and en-US are recorded below.
